text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Acting Manager! A virgin mojito.
Deliver it to that table with the speed of lightning!
choice_data_list: Thanks! I'll go serve it right away!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... All because I got injured, I had to ask someone to fill in for me...
choice_data_list: Not at all. We should always help each other out in times of need!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Tanino Gimlet's friends came to cheer her on.
With this, we should be able to see it through!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now—pass me the orders imitating Bacchus!
The die is cast. Seize destiny with your own hands!

text_block_list.name: Bar Customer
text_block_list.text:
Wheee... *hic*. Heyyy! Bring me my booze
already! What's takin' ya so long, huh?
choice_data_list: I'm sorry... We're a bit short-handed...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Wait a moment.
It won't be long now. —Wait there.

text_block_list.name: Bar Customer
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... S-Sorry about making such a racket...
...I said I'm sorry! Don't glare at me like that!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! You've acted like a hero's loyal retainer!
Keep it up, and continue confronting this lawless chaos!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Serving is complete on this side too.
—Awaiting your next command.
choice_data_list: Oh, quick work! In that case, could you clean up?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... As expected of the unblemished holy sword. Unbroken, unchipped—I can see why Roland didn't want to let go of you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I merely fulfilled my duty as a knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“...Still, yes. This work
is truly rewarding... Hehe.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, while things went smoothly at first after being entrusted with the role of acting store manager—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: One order――of a Saratoga Cooler, please.
choice_data_list: Got it! This one's non-alcoholic, so... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the recipe for a Saratoga Cooler,
it seems lime is required... but right now,
we happen to be fresh out.
choice_data_list: Sorry! Lime, could you take care of this!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
As for shopping, I shall—huph!

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is the kind of establishment that can't even serve a customer's first drink as ordered? —I'm leaving.

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. If you stand there,
I won't be able to get out. Would you mind moving?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I won't let you regret it, my lady.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All I ask for is a little time.
As long as I have that, I promise to deliver—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An endless intoxication, without fail.
I swear it upon the River Styx!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha~!
choice_data_list: Please have a seat, honored guest.

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text:
"...Believe it or not, I'm quite a well-known writer.
I carry a fair amount of influence in these circles."

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text:
If you take up my time and serve me a dreadful cup
—you know what happens, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...As Tanino Gimlet's Trainer, I was able to answer that question immediately—
choice_data_list: Yes. I am certain she will satisfy you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've witnessed it more than anyone else.
The moments she declared she would achieve it—and then did."
choice_data_list: Please keep watching. Watch as she lives up to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I see— And here I thought I had noticed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Your hopes, your longing, your passion.
How they brought me—to this fleeting instant.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... tonight, I feel as though I could craft a drink
that would tempt even the moon goddess—into wild intoxication.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting.
Here is your Saratoga Cooler.

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text:
...!!! This is, seriously...
so much spicier than the normal one...

text_block_list.name: Connoisseur Customer
text_block_list.text:
W-What did you use as the secret ingredient? Ginger?
Or maybe cardamom...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! It's nothing of the sort!
The secret ingredient I sprinkled in is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It is trust entrusted by an irreplaceable existence.
